## Towed Array Data

-   **Encounter Information:** Link to [AC_FKW_Encounters](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BK5xezOtL3sSQy4PFtc8o3f1anFRbcDFygFNgcaz9RE/edit?usp=sharing)

-   **Processed Data:** Stored `C:\FKW_Outputs`

Name the header folder for encounters with the AC_ID (Crusie#AC; ex. 1705067)

Setup folder structure for each encounter:

-   1_TDOA

    -   Data

        -   Raw_CrossCorrelogram

    -   Results

-   2_Extract-PG

    -   Data

        -   Extracted_tables

        -   Pamguard_database_sqlite3

    -   Results

-   3_Localize

    -   Data

        -   Crosscorrelograms

        -   GPSandPos_info

        -   Pamguard_detections

        -   Raw_GPSandArray_info

        -   TDOA_tracks

    -   Results
